EnableAnchorLinks.Name: Jump to journal headings
EnableAnchorLinks.Hint: Pins dragged from a journal's table of contents open the journal at that heading. Disabled automatically if JAL or D&D Beyond Importer is active.

EnableDynamicIcons.Name: Auto-numbered pin icons
EnableDynamicIcons.Hint: Pins whose label starts with a short code get a round icon showing it, e.g. '1a. Strange Door' shows '1a'.

EnableIconBorderRemoval.Name: Remove pin icon borders
EnableIconBorderRemoval.Hint: Draw pin icons without the dark background square. Disabled automatically if Backgroundless Pins or Pin Cushion is active.

EnableContentPins.Name: Image and text pins
EnableContentPins.Hint: Drag an image, or a selection of text, out of a journal page onto the map to make a pin that opens that image or jumps to that text.

Labels.ImageHint: Double-clicking the pin opens this image instead of the journal.
Labels.TextHint: Double-clicking the pin opens the page and highlights this text.
Labels.ShareImageHint: When the GM double-clicks the pin, the image is shown to every player too.

Notifications.TextNotFound: Couldn't find the pinned text on this page. It may have been edited.
